exposure: medication use (MMI, PTU, no anti-thyroid drug)
cohort: 408 pregnant women with thyrotoxicosis and a control group of age and parity matched low-risk pregnancies
finding: Thyrotoxicosis, regardless of treatment, is associated with an increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, particularly for those requiring ATD treatment.
mod_finding: Thyrotoxicosis during pregnancy, regardless of treatment, was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (LBW) was measured as an outcome.
